name: Combat Freighter
materials: Native reference projections and existing fleet metal trims, three embedded 2048px PBR maps. Amber is paint; only cyan drives emission.
units: Relative model units; gameplay scale is assigned at integration
generator: Python/NumPy, existing fleet reconstruction workflow; no Blender
textures: Native five-view pixels; dedicated bottom projection; continuous cylinder walls; reference-matched ImageGen material swatches on hidden edges and fittings
optimization: Static parts merged by material; exact vertex deduplication; 16-bit indices
note: Orthographic concept reconstruction. Production integration supplies dedicated map/panel art and three engine hardpoints; gameplay rules are unchanged.
geometry: One armored cargo citadel, two clamshell doors, four folded three-finger grapple arms, three level engines.
uvFallbackPolicy: Invalid UV charts fail the build.
stage: Static source model; production uses the verified LOD2 export.
